scope: Proposition 7.1 (Meaning of the finite assertions) of the manuscript “Triangular minimality for planar Coulomb renormalized energy” (preprints/Triangular-minimality-for-planar-Coulomb-renormalized-energy-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 090 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6f640e977aed5d3b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Apply the outward interval procedure specified in this section to the radial data (5.7), retaining modes 0 through 38, with the parameters in the table. If every listed assertion holds, its enclosures establish the finite-core premise (6.5), the exterior positivity (7.22), the primitive bound outside the interior of D0, the negative-part bound for every d ≥ b, and the convexity bound (7.33), all for the exact infinite-mode functions.
